The next steps are generic.","problems":["Headline claims 'charts support billing' yet the rationale says possible inflation; mixed message for an investigator.","Cited claims are a poor fit: C0035831 is the one below-billed chart, but C0035757 and C0035769 are low-complexity 99215 examples that are not tied to the note-inflation findings (data review, bulk-created, paste-heavy).","Next step only says request a targeted sample of 99215 charts starting with the three cited claims; it ignores the better leads from note_checks (C0035778, C0035946, C0035785 flagged for late, data, bulk or paste).","'99215 share is high in every complexity stratum' is stated without numbers; the card has them, e.g. 20.6% vs 2.4% at 0 conditions.","'30% are duplicates' comes from tool output and is not explained; the duplicate sign is not defined in the summary.","Does not flag that the sample of 11 documented 99215 claims is small, or that MISSING_RESULTS was a deficiency in the records exchange.","The 48% low-complexity figure for 99215 is presented without counts, and the 'late 17%' and similar rates lack baseline comparison."]}
